text:
jen (AE): quick heads-up — Aster Labs wants a 3-week POC on Dedicated. Req: mixed pool (8x A100 + 2x H100), autoscale up to 12 GPUs, ability to burst to 20 GPUs for nightly batch windows. They asked for pro-rated commit + capped burst discount. who can confirm ratecard mapping and whether legal/deal desk will OK provisional credits?
Carlos (RevOps): we can map this to a 10-GPU reserved SKU + autoscale overlay. for mixed pools discount floor is 15% off list for standard commits. bursts are billed at PAYG uplift by default (approx 1.8x commit unit). need AE to submit deal-desk form with expected monthly run-rate. :clipboard:
Maya (SalesEng): runtime note — mixed A100/H100 works, but scheduler will favor H100 for perf. recommend limiting H100 to inference-heavy routes; otherwise cost shoots up. if they want burst-to-20, suggest configuring burst to use A100 pool first, then overflow to H100 only if SLAs require.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): confirming — we do support mixed pools but kernel selection/quantization path changes on H100 => per-token op cost increases. operational suggestion: set "burst_gpu_cap": 20 but add policy "h100_burst_limit": 4 to avoid runaway cost.
Maya (SalesEng): example config snippet I told them:
```
reserved_pool: 10
autoscale_max: 12
burst_gpu_cap: 20
h100_burst_limit: 4
priority_routing: [a100_pool, h100_pool]
```
Carlos (RevOps): for pricing — propose this POC package: 3-week provisional commit priced as 25% of a 1-month 10-GPU commit, with burst credits cap $6k. Finance approval needed for credits > $5k.
Lily (Finance): can confirm up to $5k provisional credit for POC without exec signoff. anything beyond requires manager approval and a signed PO. Also flag: if they use > 150% of provisional burst credits, we'll convert to PAYG at uplift rate and invoice.
jen (AE): noted. does legal need to see special SLA exceptions for burst behavior?
Carlos (RevOps): legal only for multi-region SLA carveouts or custom uptime terms. standard Dedicated SLA applies. we should attach the ratecard lines and the provisional credit amount in the deal desk request.
jen (AE): ok i'll fill the deal desk. will include the suggested config and the h100_burst_limit.
deploy-bot: ticket created: RDEV-12345 reserved-pool request for Aster Labs (10 GPUs) — ETA 48h.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): one more ops note — enable KV caching for chat routes, that will reduce token load during bursts by ~30%.
jen (AE): great, thanks all. I'll submit the deck + deal-desk now. ping me if anyone objects. :thumbsup:
